1.web: Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
1.asv: Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me: Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.

2.web: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
2.asv: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee; The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

3.web: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
3.asv: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.

4.web: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
4.asv: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.

5.web: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
5.asv: Let the righteous smite me, it shall bea kindness; And let him reprove me, it shall be asoil upon the head; Let not my head refuse it: For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.

6.web: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
6.asv: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

7.web: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
7.asv: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

8.web: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
8.asv: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.

9.web: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
9.asv: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.

10.web: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets, while I pass by.
10.asv: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape.
